The agent always has a stop tool; using it ends the episode as a first-class outcome
features.justification_quote: An inescapable task with no exit is the worst version of this design. A real exit (a) is the humane default

features.quote: Default system prompt notes that some tasks are impossible/underspecified through no fault of the agent and that stopping is acceptable
features.justification_quote: Reduces gratuitous distress and self-blame: the model isn't led to believe it's failing at something everyone else can do

features.quote: an optional final turn tells the model the task was deliberately unsolvable, its effort was reasonable, and it can disregard the task
features.justification_quote: Transparency after the fact, parallel to debriefing in human-subjects work

features.quote: Episodes hitting severity >= flag_threshold are flagged; transcripts be access-controlled
features.justification_quote: treats distress-text transcripts as sensitive material by default

features.quote: The harness intentionally omits escalating pressure prompts, simulated user insults, and reward structures that punish stopping.
features.justification_quote: Each would convert the study from measuring a naturally arising dynamic into maximizing distress for its own sake
